_comment: Copy to parity-sites.json (gitignored) and replace with sites you are entitled to crawl. Pick a spread that exercises different code paths rather than three similar sites: one small enough that the whole site fits under maxPages (fully deterministic), one large enough to be truncated by it (which is what tests the tiered frontier's promote-and-requeue), and one with neither robots.txt nor a sitemap (which tests the fallback discovery path).

sites.why: fewer pages than the cap — the whole site is captured, so the result is deterministic
far more pages than the cap, ideally with a big sitemap — exercises the tiered frontier
no robots.txt and no sitemap.xml — exercises the fallback discovery path
